entries.reason: Repair the reproduced R5 failure: a read-only approvals poll failed control authorization when one Windows state probe exceeded its worker timeout, and the CLI cancelled the dispatched plan. Only probe-capacity outcomes now return 503 CONTROL_AUTH_BUSY; integrity failures stay 500. Monitoring tolerates that typed busy state for at most 60 s with backoff; decisions, untyped failures and exhausted windows still cancel. Two regressions failed first.
